title_en: 2026 UAM Future Talent Development Open Special Lecture
summary: The Korea Transportation Safety Authority invites university and graduate students across Korea who are interested in Urban Air Mobility (UAM) to attend an open special lecture; attendance is voluntary. The lecture takes place on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, from 10:00 to 12:00 on the Main Stage, Hall 2, KINTEX Exhibition Center 1. Students may apply through the QR code on the poster by Sunday, 1 November 2026, 24:00, or register on site.
applies_to: University and graduate students nationwide who are interested in UAM. Attendance is voluntary, not mandatory.

dates.what: Application deadline (QR application through the poster)

The lecture is held in connection with the 2026 Drone and Urban Air Mobility Expo.

translation:
2026 UAM Future Talent Development Open Special Lecture

The Korea Transportation Safety Authority is holding an open special lecture for future talent, intended for university and graduate students interested in UAM (Urban Air Mobility), as described below. We encourage many students to attend.

A. Program title: 2026 UAM Future Talent Development Open Special Lecture

B. Date/time: Wednesday, 4 November 2026, 10:00–12:00

C. Venue: Main Stage, Hall 2, KINTEX Exhibition Center 1
* Held in connection with the 2026 Drone and Urban Air Mobility Expo

D. Organisers: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport; Korea Transportation Safety Authority

E. Eligible participants: University and graduate students nationwide

F. Application period: Until Sunday, 1 November 2026, 24:00

G. How to participate: Apply via the QR code on the poster, or register on site

H. Lecture content:
1) Commercialisation trends in the UAM industry and technology
2) Current status and roadmap of eVTOL aircraft development
3) Current status of UAM air traffic control and traffic management system development
* See the attached file for details.
